summary.intent: Rename a branch to a better name and add Nyquist validation contracts (VALIDATION.md) for the 4 phases (28, 29, 30, 32) that were missing them, as part of a v1.1 docs/verification closeout.
summary.outcome: Branch renamed to `docs/v1.1-verification-nyquist-closeout`; VALIDATION.md authored for all 4 missing phases via multi-agent workflow with adversarial spot-checking; audit/milestone/tech-debt docs updated to reflect 0 missing VALIDATION.md files; one doc accuracy fix applied to phase 28; commit amended.

repo: Phase 34 already had a VALIDATION.md (authored 2026-06-12) — the v1.1-MILESTONE-AUDIT.md Nyquist 'missing' list was stale (dated 2026-06-11) and incorrectly included it.
Phase 28 nyquist_compliant=true is defensible: all SCs are static hygiene invariants (0 console.*, 0 as any, POC dir removed) verifiable by grep, not runtime tests.
Phase 29 headline behavior (delete→unenroll wiring via fireAndForgetUnenroll, collectSubtreeIpnsNames recursion) ships with zero automated tests — overlaps existing todo #15.
Phase 30 has a real dead-code bug: registerFaroTransport is unreachable because the logger has no transports array — this is exactly todo #16.
Phase 32 E2E covers the async main-push path but unit tier is missing for drain/dedup and poll-wait/EIO handling.
28-VALIDATION.md incorrectly referenced 'apps/web/vite.config.ts' for test config — actual config is 'apps/web/vitest.config.ts'; vite.config.ts contains no test configuration.
upload-error-recovery.test.ts was misleadingly cited as behavioral evidence for SC2 logging guarantee in phase 28 — it contains no logger mocks or assertions.

code.finding: ipns.service.spec.ts line ~1500 contains a describe('unenrollBatch') block with exactly 4 tests — the only real test coverage for phase 29's headline feature.
apps/web/src/lib/faro.ts privacy scrubber (scrubObject/scrubValue/beforeSend, HEX_KEY_PATTERN) has zero automated tests despite being pure deterministic logic — highest-priority test gap.
registerFaroTransport is dead code — logger object has no transports array, so the function can never execute. Flagged as real bug in VALIDATION.md, cross-referenced to todo #16.
delete.service.test.ts:65 asserts logger.warn on quota-reconcile failure, providing the only runtime evidence for SC1/SC2 logging in phase 28.

workflow: Multi-agent Nyquist workflow with per-phase skeptic/adversarial spot-check is effective for retroactive validation doc authoring — caught doc accuracy issues that a single-pass agent missed.
Retroactive VALIDATION.md should be authored via static analysis only (grep/fs invariants, no test suite runs) when the branch is docs-only — keeps scope clean.
Workflow output truncation in task notifications is a real risk for long results; always read the full output file before acting on results.
The GSD audit 'missing' list should be treated as potentially stale — always verify against actual filesystem state before scoping work.

friction: The v1.1-MILESTONE-AUDIT.md Nyquist missing list was stale (6 days old), causing the initial scope to include phase 34 which already had a VALIDATION.md — required a filesystem scan to correct before starting.
Task notification output was truncated (6997 chars cut) — required a separate Read of the full output file to get phase 32 results.
Phase 28 skeptic caught two doc accuracy issues (wrong config file path, misleading coverage claim) that required manual follow-up edits after the workflow completed.
open_items: Phases 29, 30, 32 are nyquist_compliant=false — test backfill required (code change, deferred to separate PRs): phase 29 needs SDK fireAndForgetUnenroll + collectSubtreeIpnsNames tests (todo #15); phase 30 needs faro.ts privacy scrubber unit tests; phase 32 needs drain/dedup and poll-wait/EIO unit tests.
Phase 30 dead-code bug: registerFaroTransport unreachable due to missing transports array on logger — tracked as todo #16, not fixed on this docs branch.
Phase 29 POST /ipns/unenroll endpoint has no ipns.controller.spec.ts — JWT scoping, 200-name cap, and IPNS regex are static-grep-verified only.
8 phases with 'partial' VALIDATION.md status still exist — pushing them to fully Nyquist-compliant requires writing tests (code change, out of scope for this docs branch).

Phase 28 plan deviation noted: 28-04 called for a 00-Preliminary-R&D/ARCHIVED.md provenance note that was never created — the whole parent dir was removed instead; SC satisfied via git history but deviation is undocumented in plan.
